name: Tensor Glyphs
definition: Objects at every data point representing scalar, vectorial, or tensorial information (eigenvalues/eigenvectors) to overcome the limitation of colormaps displaying only three metrics.
summary: Tensor Glyphs visualize tensor data using geometric primitives like superquadrics to unambiguously represent diffusion orientation and anisotropy, overcoming the limitations of colormaps and simpler glyphs.
